phenomenon_question_hypothesis.phenomenon: Set-level Assembly or unit impairment can be compatible with multiple distinct delayed recurrent transmission structures, so coarse lesion effects do not uniquely identify temporal routes.
phenomenon_question_hypothesis.question: On a fixed trained v0.5 checkpoint, can a bounded prospectively frozen family of physical edge transmission and delay interventions identify specified lagged route features supporting a target Assembly beyond the interventional equivalence class left by Assembly/unit lesions?
phenomenon_question_hypothesis.hypothesis: Some target-Assembly edge/lag features are separable from matched random/sham and prior lesion reductions, but unique whole-network topology should not be claimed unless the complete frozen intervention family separates all predeclared alternatives relevant to that claim.

pool: reservoir edges with target in target Assembly prototype and source in prototype
one-hop non-receptor reservoir ingress edges with target in target Assembly prototype
prospective_ranking: both endpoints in prototype before ingress-only

observables: target Assembly activation/maturity rate and similarity
target-prototype non-receptor spike response by relative-time bin
exact intervention target mapping and edge metadata

interventions.target_transmission_null: set selected edge weight to 0.0 on a deep-copied quiescent anchor before evaluation episode
interventions.target_delay_perturbation: add 4*pattern_temporal_bin_ms = 1.0 ms to selected edge delay on a separate clone
interventions.sham: same clone/evaluation path with original edge values reassigned unchanged
interventions.matched_random_edge_controls: prospectively match non-target reservoir edge by sign and coarse weight/delay strata; fail closed if no valid match rather than relax post-outcome

observable_intervention.source_pulse_ids_exclusion_reason: Transmission-null can still materialize zero-current arrivals that affect provenance bookkeeping without carrying dynamical current.

ordinary_reductions_comparators: interventional-equivalence-class reporting when alternatives remain unresolved

falsifier_discriminator.unique_feature_falsifier: For every route feature claimed, predeclare at least one structurally distinct alternative compatible with coarse Assembly/unit lesions. If two alternatives have the same complete response signature under the entire frozen candidate #34 intervention family, unique identification of their distinguishing feature is falsified and the claim collapses to the corresponding interventional equivalence class.
falsifier_discriminator.target_specificity_falsifier: If target edge/timing effects are not more selective or informative than matched random/sham and prior lesion reductions, reject that edge/lag feature as identified.
falsifier_discriminator.reachability_falsifier: If quiescent anchoring or deterministic matched-control construction is unreachable without changing stable dynamics, HOLD/revise prospectively rather than weaken the contract after results.

implementation.diagnostic_description: Inspected stable delayed-edge representation, event scheduling, deep-copy evaluation path, Assembly temporal representation, and retained lesion evaluator to determine whether target edge-weight and edge-delay interventions are reachable without changing stable scientific dynamics.

observations.connection_mutability: Connection contains mutable weight and delay_ms fields.
observations.future_propagation_reachability: TemporalExcitableField outgoing lists reference the stored Connection objects and read edge.weight/edge.delay_ms when a source spike schedules a future SynapticArrival.
observations.deepcopy_reachability: Retained causal evaluator already evaluates independent deep-copied trained brains, so branch-isolated target/sham/random edge edits are architecturally reachable.
observations.material_queue_caveat: Already queued SynapticArrival objects contain fixed time_ms/current. Connection edits do not retroactively change them, so interventions require a quiescent post-training anchor.
observations.proposed_quiescent_anchor: Advance without new input in existing 32 ms settle increments for at most 8 increments/256 ms and require pending event queue empty before intervention; if not empty, fail closed for reassessment.
observations.zero_weight_semantics: Weight=0 is transmission-null rather than literal edge deletion because a zero-current arrival may still be scheduled and affect provenance bookkeeping.
observations.assembly_temporal_surface: Assembly patterns already expose ordered_units and relative_bins over non-receptor internal spikes at 0.25 ms temporal bins.
observations.new_information_gain: Discovery R1 now has a concrete temporal object, bounded intervention/control family, implementation reachability boundary, and explicit queue/provenance caveat that was not specified at QFD stage.
